bull.b: The sharp improvement in quarterly revenue, gross margin, and adjusted EBITDA indicates stronger operating momentum across the combined business. If these gains persist, they can improve the company’s ability to convert rapid top-line growth into increasingly durable earnings power.

A substantial locked-in revenue base and full agency-client renewals provide useful forward visibility beyond individual campaigns or events. This supports planning, reduces dependence on constant customer replacement, and strengthens confidence in management’s near-term operating outlook.

TubeBuddy adds a high-margin software component to GameSquare’s media and marketing portfolio, while AI-led subscriber growth may improve monetization. Stronger conversion among activated users could create a scalable, recurring contribution that diversifies service revenue.

bear.b: Revenue growth and better gross margins have not yet translated into sustainable profitability. Very large operating and net losses leave the company dependent on continued growth and disciplined cost control, making the earnings model vulnerable if expansion slows.

Persistent operating and free-cash-flow deficits mean the business is not currently funding its activities internally. Continued cash consumption can restrict investment flexibility and increase reliance on external capital until profitability and working-capital performance improve.

The proposed stock-based FanEngine transaction could materially dilute existing shareholders, with further earnout shares and contingent cash payments possible. Although the deal may expand capabilities and growth, its financing structure could reduce each existing holder’s ownership.
